title: Give each business invariant one authoritative owner
supabiz_proposal: Define stable stock/matter identities and route all protected mutations through one authoritative state boundary.

title: Choose entity boundaries before choosing actor count
supabiz_proposal: Test matter, stock-item/location and order boundaries; avoid one global business bottleneck or one unrelated actor per message.

title: Persist through explicit reviewed commands
supabiz_proposal: Use assignment-safe updates or append-only SQL events; restore tests must catch in-memory-only edits.
measure: Lost state after reload; mutation mistakes

title: Make atomicity an explicit contract
supabiz_proposal: Pin method transaction behavior; validate failure and rollback rather than relying on introductory documentation.
measure: Partial business commits; incorrect rollback assumptions

title: Keep slow AI work outside critical mutations
supabiz_proposal: Save intent/version, perform bounded model work, then revalidate and apply through a short guarded command.

title: Separate durable records from ephemeral progress
supabiz_proposal: Persist business decisions and evidence; keep disposable token/typing/cache state ephemeral.

title: Treat external outcomes as independently verified
supabiz_proposal: Keep durable inbound dedupe and effect identities; reconcile provider outcome before repeating a write.

title: Expose uncertain outcomes honestly
supabiz_proposal: Show awaiting verification when a response is lost; do not quietly retry or claim failure/success.

title: Use shared committed views across devices
supabiz_proposal: Show permitted live state with pending/committed/verified distinctions and reconnect freshness.

title: Show what changed and why
supabiz_proposal: Compare old/new values with request, source evidence, reviewer and version; preserve selected history while showing newer updates.

title: Separate trace replay from action retry
supabiz_proposal: Label inspect history, evaluate change, retry unresolved action and compensate clearly.
measure: Accidental duplicate effects; misleading replay controls

title: Enforce authorization above project credentials
supabiz_proposal: Authorize actor/method/evidence by business and matter; project session alone is too broad for end users.

title: Design each live view for its audience
supabiz_proposal: Emit minimal allowed fields; tags are trusted routing data, not proof of permission.

title: Revoke active connections as well as grants
supabiz_proposal: Close or reauthorize established sockets after permission changes; expiry at admission is insufficient.

title: Use alarms as wake-up hints for durable deadlines
supabiz_proposal: Store all deadlines/reminder IDs; reconcile one alarm slot with next due item and test separate commit behavior.
measure: Missed or replaced reminders; duplicate notices

title: Bound admitted work independently of persistence
supabiz_proposal: Use a durable work ledger, queue limits, tenant quotas and visible backpressure.
measure: Crash-lost jobs; overload and memory growth

title: Adopt isolation with scoped tools and egress
supabiz_proposal: Validate sandbox controls and restrict secrets/destinations; infrastructure isolation does not supply business roles.

title: Measure end-to-end latency and idle cost
supabiz_proposal: Separate model, queue, activation, commit, network and review time; include control-plane and warm-node baseline.
measure: p95 completion; cost per verified outcome

title: Keep storage authority and projections explicit
supabiz_proposal: Choose one source of truth per invariant; derive search/reporting views with versions and lag repair.

title: Compare against a simpler baseline before adopting
supabiz_proposal: Evaluate a pinned Terse experiment against relational transactions plus durable jobs at equal outcomes and load.
measure: Total cost; recovery quality; engineering effort
